comments: Input facts: ego is the car responder; agent1 is the pedestrian initiator; one actor travels along the trafficway and the other crosses it without traveling along or onto another trafficway. Chosen assumptions: agent1 initiates a diagonal crossing from the right toward the left and 5 m upstream toward the approaching ego, without joining another trafficway. Ego follows its lane and brakes when agent1 is within 12–15 m. Initial longitudinal separation is 22–28 m; right lateral offset is 4–5 m; pedestrian speed is 1.5–1.9 m/s; ego target speed is 7–9 m/s. No collision outcome is required. Adjacent lanes are not needed; the road fields do not forbid them.
